properties.short_description: 'Ol' Blue Eyes', the defining American crooner: 'Fly Me to the Moon', 'My Way', 'My Kind of Town (Chicago Is)' and the Rat Pack years in Las Vegas.
The 'King of Cool': Rat Pack crooner of 'That's Amore' and 'Everybody Loves Somebody', star of his own NBC variety show.
Singer, dancer and actor, the Rat Pack's all-round entertainer: 'The Candy Man', 'Mr. Bojangles'.
'I Left My Heart in San Francisco'; the jazz-pop stylist Sinatra called the best singer in the business.
Velvet-voiced pianist and singer of 'Unforgettable' and 'Mona Lisa', raised in Chicago's Bronzeville.
The 'First Lady of Song', the great jazz vocalist of the Songbook albums.
'Fever' and 'Is That All There Is?'; a cool, intimate jazz-pop voice.
'Mack the Knife' and 'Beyond the Sea'; the swinging heir to Sinatra.
Bandleader whose orchestra backed Sinatra at the Sands in 1966.
Relaxed baritone of 'Catch a Falling Star' and decades of TV Christmas specials.
'Moon River' and a 1960s variety show that made him a household name.
Satchmo: trumpet pioneer and singer of 'What a Wonderful World'; his Chicago years in the 1920s changed jazz.
Father of Chicago blues; electrified the Delta sound at Chess Records on the South Side.
'At Last' (1960), recorded for Chicago's Chess Records.
Chicago jazz pianist whose 'The In Crowd' (1965) was a crossover smash.
Chicago soul group led by Curtis Mayfield; 'People Get Ready' (1965).
Horn-driven rock band formed in Chicago in 1967: '25 or 6 to 4', 'Saturday in the Park'.
'Over the Rainbow'; a legendary concert and film voice.
The King of Rock and Roll, from 'Heartbreak Hotel' to the Las Vegas years.
'Queen of the Blues'; 'What a Diff'rence a Day Makes' (1959); grew up on Chicago's South Side.
The original crooner: 'White Christmas', 'Swinging on a Star' and the Road movies with Bob Hope.

Audrey Hepburn and Rex Harrison in Lerner and Loewe's musical; eight Oscars.
Audrey Hepburn as Holly Golightly, with Henry Mancini's 'Moon River'.
Julie Andrews and Dick Van Dyke in Disney's practically perfect musical.
Dustin Hoffman, Anne Bancroft and the songs of Simon & Garfunkel.
